concern_results.conclusion: git_environment() pops all listed keys and prefixes and is applied at every subprocess site in the diff. Candidate.bind batches rev-parse and validates the 3-line output. changed() still runs an uncached digest(). In check-size-budget.sh, the porcelain -z parsing with --no-renames is sound, and the base-count reuse keyed on SHA-1 is sound. No functional defect is visible.

The scrub removes routing and config-override variables before git and before the four reviewer child CLIs run, and it does not set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL to /dev/null, so safe.directory keeps working. The pre-init transcript sweep only touches entries that match the UUID pattern in the sample's own project slug and skips symlinked dirs. No unsafe mutation found.

A missing base blob or missing base_oids degrades to reference_line_trend_partial (unknown). Errors from the moved head census still degrade the counter rather than aborting. A malformed rev-parse output raises CalledProcessError, the same as the previous failure shape.

10c2 poisons the env and checks every child env plus the bound head. 10f1b covers new untracked files. g10b covers CR-only base parity. h1 caps the git calls. The SIGTERM pre-init subtest is present. I found no test that would still pass with the risky behavior enabled.
